implementation.upgrade: route-bound caller-observed outcome receipts with route digest, request identity, model digest, generation, freshness, endpoint membership, evidence digest, replay detection, and explicit non-authority semantics

measured_validation.benchmark_scope: local_deterministic_route planning and route-bound receipt admission; excludes model, network, cryptographic-provider, tool, accelerator, and kernel latency

research_inputs.finding: NVIDIA Dynamo documents disaggregated serving, KV-aware routing, cache management, autoscaling, and integration with vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM.
research_inputs.used_for: provider-neutral route and cache-affinity signal boundary without embedding a vendor runtime in kernel space

research_inputs.finding: vLLM documents PagedAttention, continuous batching, prefix caching, speculative decoding, disaggregated prefill/decode/encode, parallelism, tool calling, reasoning parsers, and multimodal/hardware support.
research_inputs.used_for: request and runtime signal requirements; no provider-specific authority is imported

research_inputs.finding: LangGraph documents durable execution, persistence, checkpointing, human-in-the-loop interruption, long-term memory, streaming, fault tolerance, and observability for stateful agents.
research_inputs.used_for: binding route feedback to durable request identity and execution generation rather than free-floating heuristics

research_inputs.finding: MCP treats tools as arbitrary code-execution paths, tool annotations as untrusted unless trusted, and emphasizes consent, privacy, authorization, and user control.
research_inputs.used_for: explicit non-authority boundary: route outcomes and provider metadata cannot authorize tools or side effects

limitations: Outcome receipts are caller-observed integrity records, not proof of model correctness, truth, or task completion.
Evidence digests are caller-supplied content bindings; production cryptographic attestation and proof of possession are not implemented by this upgrade.
The route ledger remains local and bounded; distributed synchronization, quorum, and cross-node clock discipline are not claimed.
The benchmark measures Python control-plane overhead only and does not establish end-to-end inference performance.
No model, tool, browser, network, accelerator, authorization server, or external side effect was contacted.
This evidence does not claim AGI, production approval, hardware qualification, independent build qualification, or external security review.
